knownVisualFidelityRisks: Powertrain GLB crank geometry encodes alternating throw geometry rather than fully matching the required 1-and-4 / 2-and-3 crank phase grouping.
Generated cylinder block uses simplified solid cylinder features and does not provide manufacturing-accurate hollow bores or clearance against moving pistons.
Rod, piston, journal and pin visual meshes are based on conceptual radii; mathematically exact pivot positions are not licensed CAD/STEP datums.
Valve timing belt, pulley teeth, cam lobe profiles and differential gears are visual approximations and cannot be used to verify gear engagement.
scope: Analytic slider-crank kinematics and state-machine teardown/assembly without manufacturing or real mechanical safety claims

additionalParametricBrepReference.statement: BRep STEP export is not evidence of licensed OEM geometry, tolerance validation or collision-free operation
